outputs.explanation: The 'plots' in this panel are spatial gene-expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections (Log2 Exp color scale), not summary bar/mean charts. Heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points overlay.
This panel consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs only; it contains no averaged/summary plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
The panel is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual TCGA patient tumor value (n=500 LUSC, n=512 LUAD) with median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are already displayed.
The bar chart (mean ± SD) has individual replicate dots (n=3 per group) overlaid on each bar, satisfying the requirement to show individual data points behind the average.
